areas.name: uk-rates
areas.description: UK tax-year rates and thresholds verified against gov.uk: income tax, National Insurance, minimum wage, student loans, VAT, ISA, pensions, stamp duty, capital gains, State Pension.
areas.cadence: Every 6 April (new tax year) and after each Budget or Autumn Statement; minimum wage on 1 April; every source page re-fetched weekly.

areas.name: uk-exams
areas.description: UK exam-board specifications verified against the boards' own pages: which topic sits on which paper, durations, marks, weightings. AQA GCSE sciences and maths so far.
areas.cadence: Each September and on any published specification update; every source page re-fetched weekly.

areas.name: vehicles
areas.description: Official vehicle recall datasets: DVSA (UK), RappelConso (France) and MLIT (Japan) recalls and complaints; EU Safety Gate is a stub.

areas.name: software-eol
areas.description: Support and end-of-life dates for 14 runtimes and operating systems (endoflife.date snapshot): dataset additions, new cycles, moved or reached end-of-life dates
